about: Every setting a saved style can carry, once, under its saved name. Written by tools/settings-list.mjs from presets.js, reading-panel.js, plugin/words.php, tools/split_style.py and functions.php. It is also a source: presets.js's tables (DIALS, OPTS, the lists, PICKS, LEVELS, ROLES, ROLE_DEFAULT, MEMBERS, the aliases, the meanings) are a block written from it, and split_style.py reads REST (rest, restValues) and ABSENT from it. Change a table here and run node tools/settings-list.mjs. {role}, {member} and {side} stand for the ids in roles and sides.

means.roles: Typography by role. head: titles and headings. read: article body. quote: block quotes. kicker: the category line under a title. small: dates, tags, captions, the author line. comment: the comment thread. ui: the interface. title: section titles in the rail and archive. Each role takes face, weight, size (px at desktop width), tracking (m25 to p25, letter spacing in per mille steps, default is none), words (word spacing, same steps), caps, italic, leading. head and kicker also take align (default, the theme's own start; center; right) and colour (ink, the rest; accent; own, the well colours.<side>.head or .kicker). members are named sub-groups of a role that may take their own size, weight, caps and tracking, and under head also align, so the headings inside an article (sub) can stay left under a centred title; a member left out follows its role.
means.colours: The style's own paper (page background), ink (text) and accent (links) per side, as hex; also, since 2026-09-26, button (the filled buttons), head and kicker (the roles' own colours, with roles.head.colour or roles.kicker.colour own), ground (the page around the paper) and lift (what stands on the paper: menus, buttons, filled boxes). Every other colour is mixed from these. Ink on paper must reach 4.5:1 and accent on paper 3:1 on both sides.
means.effects: The extras' details, one object per effect (title, serif, arrival, cardlight, moving, button, pattern, guides, tint, aurora, pointer, dividers, topline, picglow), each holding only the details that differ from their rest; the effect's own switch is its flat pick (titlefinish, headitalics, headarrival, cardlight, buttonfinish, toppattern, guides, greytint, pageglow, movinglight) or, for the last four, its look.

roles.label: Headings
roles.where: Applies to the title and the headings in the article.

roles.label: Reading text
roles.where: Applies to the paragraphs of the article.

roles.label: Category line
roles.where: The category under the title, on the cards and in the article.

roles.label: Comments
roles.where: The names, the words and the form under the article.

roles.label: Interface
roles.where: The sidebar, the menus, the buttons and the cards.

details.label: Fades to
details.means: how far Shine fades, the share of the colour it ends on: 50 (the rest), 70 or 30.

details.label: Direction
details.means: which way the finish runs: diagonal (the rest, top left to bottom right), down, or across.

details.label: Colour
details.means: the colour the Accent finish runs into: light (the rest; the accent until a Light is set), second (Second light), accent or ink.

details.label: Reaches
details.means: all headings (the rest) or the title alone.

details.label: Which words
details.means: which words of a heading take the serif of Italics in headings: the italics a writer set (the rest), the last word of every title and heading, or the whole title.

details.label: Style
details.means: italic (the rest) or upright.

details.label: Speed
details.means: calm (the rest), quick or slow.

details.label: Blur
details.means: how blurred the words start with Blur to sharp: medium (8, the rest), light (4) or strong (14).

details.label: Also
details.means: the headings only (the rest), the paragraphs too, or the paragraphs and the pictures too.

details.label: Strength
details.means: its strength in percent: 100 (the rest), 25, 50 or 75.

details.label: Colour
details.means: auto (the rest: the ink by night, the accent by day), light, second, accent or ink.

details.label: Edge
details.means: how much of the top edge is lit: medium (70, the rest), short (40) or full (100).

details.label: Glow reach
details.means: how far the glow falls into the card: medium (55, the rest), small (35) or large (85).

details.label: Colour
details.means: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Speed
details.means: seconds a run takes: medium (7, the rest), slow (11) or fast (4).

details.label: Streak
details.means: the streak's length in percent: medium (34, the rest), short (20) or long (55).

details.label: Where
details.means: the cards (the rest), the buttons too, or the article's dividers too.

details.label: Rhythm
details.means: always (the rest) or now and then.

details.label: Glow colour
details.means: the light under the main button with Glow: fill (the rest: its own colour), light, second, accent or ink.

details.label: Glow
details.means: the glow's strength: medium (75, the rest), soft (40) or strong (100).

details.label: Ring
details.means: a ring of the glow colour round the main button: on (the rest) or off.

details.label: Lift
details.means: the main button lifts under the pointer: on (the rest) or off.

details.label: Light sweep
details.means: a band of light crosses a button under the pointer: off (the rest) or on.

details.label: Glass
details.means: how strong the glass is: medium (2, the rest), faint (1) or strong (3).

details.label: Strength
details.means: its strength in percent of today's: 100 (the rest), 25, 50 or 75.

details.label: Colour
details.means: ink (the rest), light, second or accent.

details.label: Size
details.means: medium (the rest), fine or wide.

details.label: Reach
details.means: how far down it reaches before it has faded: medium (560 px, the rest), short (300), long (900) or the whole paper.

details.label: Strength
details.means: their strength: 100 (the rest: today's), or 25, 50 or 75 percent of a share of 30.

details.label: Colour
details.means: ink (the rest), light, second or accent.

details.label: Corner marks
details.means: a small cross at the four corners: off (the rest) or on.

details.label: Tint with
details.means: the colour the greys take: light (the rest; the accent until a Light is set), second or accent.

details.label: First colour
details.means: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Second colour
details.means: second (the rest), light, accent or ink.

details.label: Place
details.means: behind the title (the rest), the top of the page, or the whole article.

details.label: Speed
details.means: slow (the rest), still or lively.

details.label: Shape
details.means: soft glows (the rest) or two beams of light.

details.label: Pointer light
details.means: a soft light under the pointer on the cards: off (the rest) or on.

details.label: Colour
details.means: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Dividers
details.means: the article's dividers: plain (the rest), fading ends, or fading ends with a glow.

details.label: Colour
details.means: the glow's colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Paper top line
details.means: a bright line along the paper's top edge: off (the rest) or on. The framed paper only.

details.label: Colour
details.means: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Picture edge light
details.means: a light at the edge of the article's pictures: off (the rest), soft or strong.

details.label: Colour
details.means: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

details.label: Curve
details.means: the frame's corner: round (the rest), slight or bulged.

details.label: Glass sheen
details.means: a faint light across the glass's top corner: off (the rest) or on.

details.label: Direction
details.means: the edges pulled in (the rest) or magnified out.

details.label: Glows on
details.means: which words glow by night: all text (the rest) or the headings only, the reading left clean.

details.label: By night
details.means: the vignette's strength on the dark side: the same as by day (the rest) or half, since a pale haze shows far more on a dark ground.

details.label: By night in
details.means: the colour the edges darken toward on the dark side: the ink (the rest), which reads as a pale haze, or black, as a screen's glass falls off into the dark.

details.label: By day
details.means: the vignette's strength on the light side: the same as set (the rest) or half.

settings.means: Always 1. Marks the JSON as a style record.
The name on the tile.
The built-in style this record starts from; every key left out rests on it. See examples for what each base is.
The colour pair (a light and a dark side designed together). colours overrides its paper, ink and accent.
settings.label: Presets

settings.means: The reading size step of the article, a fluid rung and not a pixel value; default is about 22px on a desktop. Do not set a size for a monospaced reading face, its phone floor is handled by the theme.
settings.label: Reading size

settings.means: The font of the article body.
settings.label: Font

settings.means: Line spacing of the article, from solid (tightest) to loosest; default is 1.6.
settings.label: Line spacing

settings.means: Justified paragraphs with hyphenation.
settings.label: Justified text

settings.means: A large initial on the first paragraph; capLines is its height in lines.
settings.label: Drop cap

settings.means: Rounded corners on cards, buttons and pictures. false is square.
settings.label: Rounded corners

settings.means: Hairlines around cards, buttons and fields and between rows. false means no lines anywhere except link underlines.
settings.label: Lines

settings.means: Tinted fills on cards, buttons and fields. With lines and fills both false, controls are plain glyphs.
settings.label: Fills

settings.means: By day, the ground around the page takes the style's night colours while the page stays light: the rails and the space around the paper. On other themes, the footer. Nothing changes by night.
settings.label: Dark ground

settings.means: The article's title, categories and date line stand as wide as the wide top picture, so a big title needs fewer lines; the text keeps its column.
settings.label: Wide title

settings.means: Every line at half a pixel: the cards' edges, the fields, the frame and the dividers thin to a hairline. Only with lines.
settings.label: Fine lines

settings.means: The picture effect lifts under the pointer and the real colours show. No effect when pictures is plain or hidden.
settings.label: Colour on hover

settings.means: Pictures are dimmed a little on the dark side. Applies to plain, bw, sepia and grain.
settings.label: Dim in the dark

settings.means: The article's top picture fades out toward its bottom and sides, into the paper. Not with hidden pictures.
settings.label: Fade the edges

settings.means: Pictures wear a frame: a mat in the fields' colour, and with lines a line around it. Off, a picture stands on the paper with its corner alone.
settings.label: Frame around pictures

settings.means: Faint horizontal lines over the whole page, an old screen.
settings.label: Scan lines

settings.means: A soft light around the letters in their own colour. Shows on the dark side only.
settings.label: Glow

settings.means: A fine film grain over the whole page, the tooth of paper.
settings.label: Background grain

settings.means: A darkening at the page's four edges, as a screen's glass has.
settings.label: Vignette

settings.means: The reading text is one step softer than the ink (the secondary rung); headings and bold words keep the ink. How links are marked is links.
settings.label: Softer reading text

settings.means: Inter's alternate letters: the one with a longer flag, round quotes, commas and apostrophes. Only while the interface face is Inter; the article keeps its own face's letters.
A fine grid of dots on the page ground, a cutting mat.
settings.label: Dotted background

settings.means: A highlighter: marked words and selected text get a wash in the marker colour, and a short bar stands under the article title. Decoration only, never a text colour.
settings.label: Highlighter

settings.means: The article's top picture stands wider than the text column, as wide as the paper allows.
settings.label: Wide top picture

settings.means: The tags take the buttons' corner instead of staying round.
settings.label: Tags follow the buttons

settings.means: The accent colour by name, used for links and the primary button. colours.accent overrides it.
The font of the interface: the rail, buttons, menus.
settings.label: Font

settings.means: Legacy. The theme always applies paragraph settings everywhere.

How every image on the site is shown: plain as published, bw, sepia, duo (the pair's paper and ink), accent (paper and accent, a duotone), halftone (printed dots), dither (coarse two-colour pixels), onebit (each pixel the ink or the paper, a fine random dither, as a terminal shows a picture), grain (film grain), trace (only the edges, drawn as lines in the ink, the paper showing through: a picture as a drawing has one), pixel (an ordered dither in the style's own five colours: paper, card, second light, accent and ink, as an arcade cabinet drew a picture), warm (in their own colours, a little warmer and fuller, as in late afternoon light), oldset (an old set's picture: grey, the contrast soft and the edge a little out of focus), hidden (no images; each article picture becomes a line that shows it).
settings.label: Picture effects

settings.means: Height of the initial in lines. Only with dropcap.
settings.label: Drop cap height

settings.means: What fills the main buttons: accent (the rest), ink, or own (colours.<side>.button). The links keep the accent either way.
settings.label: Button colour

settings.means: While the top picture is wide (widepicture), on stretches it edge to edge across the paper as a low banner (21:9, square corners). Off (the rest) keeps it wide.
settings.label: Picture width

settings.means: Where the line of categories stands on the article and on its cards: below the title (the rest), above it, or hidden. It replaced the switch kickerabove.
settings.label: Categories

settings.means: The buttons' and hover pills' corner: cards (the corner size's own, the rest), square, rounded (8 px) or pill. Only with rounded. The cards keep the corner size.
settings.label: Button shape

settings.means: How the main buttons look: filled (the rest), outlined, shadow (outlined with a hard shadow), tinted, gray, text (text only) or key (an arcade cabinet's button: filled, standing on a hard block of the second light, pushed into it when pressed), in the button colour where it has one.
settings.label: Main buttons

settings.means: How the other buttons (the gray secondary ones) look: gray (the rest), filled, tinted, outlined, shadow (outlined with a hard shadow) or text (text only), in the button colour where it has one.
settings.label: Other buttons

settings.means: How the quiet buttons (small actions without a fill) look: text (the rest), filled, tinted, gray, outlined or shadow (outlined with a hard shadow). Architrave's alone; another theme has no quiet kind.
settings.label: Quiet buttons

settings.means: How the tags at the end of an article look: text (the rest: words, as the theme sets them), or small pills that are filled, tinted, gray or outlined, made from the button colour. Tags follow the buttons gives the pills the buttons' corner.
settings.label: Tags

settings.means: How the chosen item is marked, the page you are on in the menu and the open tab: gray (the rest: the theme's own mark), filled with the button colour, outlined in it, or bold and underlined.
settings.label: Chosen item

settings.means: Line width in px: 1 (the rest), 2, 3 or 5. Only with lines; fine lines only at 1.
settings.label: Line width

settings.means: How cards look: box (the rest: the card's fill and, with lines, its line), top (a line along the top only, no fill, square; only with lines), flat (the fill alone, no line) or raised (the paper, lifted by a shadow), or ticks (only the four corners drawn, a drawing's crop marks, no fill; only with lines).
settings.label: Cards

settings.means: How quotes in an article look: a line at the side (the rest), plain, or in a box.
settings.label: Quotes

settings.means: How a box the writer coloured inside an article looks: flat (the rest: its fill), outlined, or raised by a shadow.
settings.label: Notes

settings.means: How search, comment and sign-up fields look: flat (the rest: the fill, with lines its line), outlined on the paper, or raised by a shadow.
settings.label: Fields

settings.means: How the title and the headings are drawn: flat (the rest: their colour), shine (from the full colour to half of it, top left to bottom right, as brushed metal), accent (from their colour into the accent), spectrum (a gradient from blue through violet and pink to orange, a step brighter by night) or violet (a gradient from blue to violet).
settings.label: Title finish

settings.means: The face of the serif words in titles and headings (which words: effects.serif): same (the rest: no serif), serif (Newsreader), classic (Libre Baskerville), vollkorn (Vollkorn) or fraunces (Fraunces).
settings.label: Italics in headings

settings.means: How the title and the article's headings come into view: none (the rest: they are simply there), fade (word by word) or blur (word by word, from a blur to sharp). Nothing moves for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Headings arrive

settings.means: Light on the cards: off (the rest), edge (a thin light along the top edge that dies out toward the corners) or glow (the edge and a faint light falling into the card). The ink by night, the accent by day.
settings.label: Card light

settings.means: A finish over the main and other buttons: flat (the rest: their look as set), glass (a faint sheet of the ink with a hairline) or glow (the main button keeps its fill and gets a soft light of the button colour under it; the other buttons glass).
settings.label: Button finish

settings.means: A pattern on the head of the paper that fades out before the reading begins: none (the rest), dots, grid, cross (small crosses) or diagonal lines.
settings.label: Pattern at the top

settings.means: Lines down each side of the article, a gutter out, as on a drawing board: off (the rest), solid or dashed. Not on a phone.
settings.label: Guides

settings.means: How much of the accent the paper, the grounds and every grey take, in percent: 0 (the rest), 5, 10 or 15. The ink itself stays as it is. Only with the style's own colour pair.
settings.label: Tint the greys

settings.means: Two slow glows of the accent behind the article's title: off (the rest), soft or strong. They stay still for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Aurora

settings.means: A short streak of the accent that travels along the top edge of the cards: off (the rest) or on. Not for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Moving light

settings.means: A black bezel around the page with rounded corners, an old monitor's frame: off (the rest), thin, medium or thick.
settings.label: Monitor frame

settings.means: A colour fringe on every letter, the three guns of a tube not quite meeting: off (the rest), faint, soft, strong, slip (print's one magenta ghost on all text) or sliptitle (that ghost on the titles and headings only, the reading left sharp).
settings.label: Colour fringe

settings.means: Letters drawn without smoothing, the stair-step of an old screen: off (the rest), headings, or all text.
settings.label: Crisp edges

settings.means: How the scan lines are drawn: lines (the rest), grille (the RGB stripes of an aperture grille), both, or dark (the dark gaps between a colour screen's rows: by night they show on what is lit and vanish on the black, and the vignette darkens; by day faint lines in the ink)., or thick (the 405 lines of the first sets: so few that each shows, a dark gap under every two bright rows). Only with scanlines.
settings.label: Scan style

settings.means: The screen's brightness moving: off (the rest), soft (a slow hum) or roll (a faint band drifting down). Still for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Shimmer

settings.means: The page bent like a tube's glass: off (the rest), slight, bulged or strong. The page is redrawn as a picture, so text softens a little.
settings.label: Warp

settings.means: The screen collapses to a line and blinks back when the side changes: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Switch-on

settings.means: The glow spilling into the paper, not only round the letters: off (the rest), soft or strong. By night only.
settings.label: Bloom

settings.means: A vertical smear while the page scrolls, the phosphor fading: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Ghosting

settings.means: The picture nudges sideways for a moment now and then, a bad sync: off (the rest), rare or often.
settings.label: Jitter

settings.means: The grain standing still (the rest) or moving, as a tube's noise crawls. Only with grain.
settings.label: Grain motion

settings.means: The article's title arrives letter by letter behind a block cursor: off (the rest), on, or decode (each letter of the title and of the article's headings runs through scrambled code glyphs before it settles, the headings as they come into view). Nothing moves for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Typed title

settings.means: A start screen on the first visit of a session, then the page: off (the rest), on (a computer's boot screen: the site's name, its line and a bar of blocks), card (a television's test card with the site's name on its plate), rain (falling lines of green code that thin away to the page), wake (three lines typed on a black screen), or coin (an arcade cabinet's attract screen: the site's name in the heading's face standing on the second light, PRESS START blinking, the credit line), or warm (no screen of its own: the page opens out of a bright line across the middle, dim and soft, and comes up to full light, as a valve set warmed up).
settings.label: Start screen

settings.means: A window reflected across the top corner of the glass: off (the rest) or on.
The whole night screen in one phosphor: off (the rest, the style's own colours), blue, green, amber, white or black.
settings.label: Phosphor

settings.means: A burst of noise while the set switches on: off (the rest) or on. Only with switchon.
settings.label: Static

settings.means: The title in the paper's colour on a block of ink, a headline over a photograph: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Drop-out title

settings.means: A rule under the title: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Title rule

settings.means: Print bleeds a hair: sharp (the rest) or spread, the letters a little softer and heavier.
settings.label: Ink

settings.means: Paper's tooth, the grain of a printed sheet: off (the rest), faint, light, medium or strong (the tooth alone at that strength) or on (the full tooth over the grain).
settings.label: Paper tooth

settings.means: The vignette's colour: ink (the rest) or yellowed, an old page's brown.
settings.label: Edges

settings.means: The article's sections in columns: 1 (the rest), 2 or 3. Each heading with its text balances into its columns and the next starts below; one column on a phone.
settings.label: Columns

settings.means: Paragraphs spaced apart (the rest) or indented with no space between, as print sets them.
settings.label: Paragraphs

settings.means: Six rainbow stripes: off (the rest), rule (on the dividers), mark (a small square before the site's name), both, or logo (the stripes fill the site's logo itself; for a logo on a transparent ground).
settings.label: Rainbow

settings.means: What stands between two posts on a page of posts: off (the rest, the theme's own gap), rainbow (the six stripes across the whole paper) or logo (the stripes with the site's logo small in a gap at their middle).
settings.label: Between posts

settings.means: What closes the page at its very foot: off (the rest), on (the six rainbow stripes as a taller band) or plate (a black plate across the paper: the site's logo and name, its tagline and the copyright line, with a faint colour fringe, the last card of a film).
settings.label: Page foot

settings.means: The side column's menu links: plain (the rest) or underlined in the ink, as a printed page sets its navigation.
settings.label: Menu

settings.means: A small italic line at the foot of the page, an advertisement's small print: the copyright sign, the year, the site's name and its tagline. Only words the site already has. Off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Legal line

settings.means: How the rainbow bands between posts and at the page foot are drawn: solid (the rest, six stripes edge to edge) or gaps (six thinner stripes with paper between them, in softer hues).
settings.label: Stripes

settings.means: The site's name in the side column and on the plate: plain (the rest, as the interface sets it), caps (bold italic capitals set tight, in the section titles' face, as an advertisement's wordmark), marquee (in the headings' face and capitals, 16px, in the accent, standing on a hard step of the second light, as an arcade cabinet's marquee) or title (in the heading role's own face, weight and slant, a size up, as a sign over the door).
settings.label: Site name

settings.means: Squared paper under the page, scrolling with it: off (the rest), squared (a hairline every 12px and a heavier one every fifth, engineering paper), fine (the small squares only) or dots (a point at each big crossing). Drawn in the ink by night, in a pale cut of it by day.
settings.label: Drawing grid

settings.means: How strongly the drawing grid shows: medium (the rest), faint or strong. Only with a drawing grid.
settings.label: Grid strength

settings.means: The edge of a drawing sheet on the paper: off (the rest), line (a heavy line on the paper's edge) or zones (the line with zone numbers along the top and foot and letters down the sides, left out where the paper's corner squares sit). Architrave's paper only.
settings.label: Sheet border

settings.means: The uneven exposure of a blueprint, large soft clouds over the paper (not grain): off (the rest), soft or strong. Dark appearance only.
settings.label: Print mottle

settings.means: The paper darkening towards its edges, as an old print does: off (the rest), soft or strong. Half as strong in light appearance.
settings.label: Print edges

settings.means: A stroke drawn round the letters of the title and the headings, which gives a single-weight face its weight: off (the rest), medium or bold.
settings.label: Pen weight

settings.means: A drawing's dimension line over the article's title (its width in pixels between two ticks) and under its opening picture: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Dimension lines

settings.means: The two faint lines a draughtsman rules before lettering (the capital height and the baseline), under every line of the article's title and headings and out to the paper's edges: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Lettering guides

settings.means: A drawing's detail mark before each of the article's section headings: a circle cut by a line, the section's number above, how many there are below. Off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Section marks

settings.means: The box every drawing carries, where the article ends: the site, the article's title, its author, its date, the scale, the sheet, the number of words and the revision, in the site's language. Off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Title block

settings.means: How far the reader is, the drawing office's way: a scale rule along the paper's foot, as wide as the column, with a cursor that walks along it. Off (the rest) or on. Architrave's paper only.
settings.label: Scale rule

settings.means: How old the cream paper looks: off (the rest), sun (warmer toward its edges and a touch at its head, as paper left in the light), spots (a few faint brown age spots) or both. On a light paper only.
settings.label: Old paper

settings.means: The ink the text is printed in by day: neutral (the rest, the style's own) or warm (the brown-black of old printed advertisements).
settings.label: Printing ink

settings.means: The six rainbow stripes as a small mark under the article's title: off (the rest), short or wide (as wide as the reading).
settings.label: Rainbow under the title

settings.means: The links in the reading underlined in the six rainbow stripes: off (the rest), hover (when the pointer is on a link) or always.
settings.label: Rainbow links

settings.means: The drop cap's letter: text (the rest, the reading text's own face and weight), bold (the reading face in bold, as the title), fraunces (a soft old-style display capital) or title (the heading role's own face, weight, slant and colour). Shows with Drop cap on.
settings.label: Drop cap font

settings.means: Where words break at the line's end: auto (the rest: with Justified text, every word that may), few (long words only, on any edge, never on two lines in a row), any (every word that may, on any edge) or off (never).
settings.label: Hyphens

settings.means: The drop cap's letter filled with the six rainbow stripes: off (the rest) or on. Shows with Drop cap on.
settings.label: Rainbow capital

settings.means: A dashed cut line with scissors above the page's foot, as old advertisements ended with an order coupon: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Coupon line

settings.means: A soft crease on the paper, as a folded brochure: off (the rest), one (down the middle) or three (two creases, three panels). On a light paper only.
settings.label: Folded brochure

settings.means: Where the yellowed edges lie: window (the rest, around the whole window) or paper (inside the framed paper's corners only, the rail clean). With Edges yellowed; a page without a frame keeps the whole window.
settings.label: Yellowed edges on

settings.means: With the dark ground on, what the rail does by night: same (the rest, dark like the page) or inverted (the rail and the ground take the day's colours beside the night's paper).
settings.label: Rail at night

settings.means: A terminal's marks in the article: off (the rest), prompt (a prompt before the category line and the headings, a blinking cursor after the date, dashes for the list's dots) or glyphs (the prompt with a run of mirrored code glyphs beside the category line and as the list's markers).
settings.label: Code marks

settings.means: Falling lines of code on the paper beside the article, never under its words: off (the rest), faint or clear. In the ink, each line's head in the accent. Still for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Code rain

settings.means: The title's and the headings' letters drawn narrower, where the heading face has a width axis (Martian Mono has): normal (the rest), narrow or narrowest. The site's name takes it too.
settings.label: Heading width

settings.means: The article set as a terminal sets it: one face at one size, every space a whole line, a blank line between paragraphs, no letter spacing and no capitals: off (the rest), double (the title alone at twice the size, as the old double-height line) or one (the title at the text's size too). On Architrave's page.
settings.label: Text grid

settings.means: The article shown as its own Markdown file: off (the rest) or on (a dim # before the title, ## before the headings, underscores round emphasis, asterisks round bold, backticks round code, dashes for the list's dots, a > before every line of a quote and a ![alt](file) line over each picture). On Architrave's page.
settings.label: Markdown marks

settings.means: The category and the date set as the head of a Markdown file, between two --- lines, the keys dim and the values in the terminal's yellow: off (the rest) or on. On Architrave's page.
settings.label: Front matter

settings.means: The page's parts drawn as a terminal draws them: off (the rest) or on (buttons as [ Words ], boxes as single-line dialogs with their name cut into the top line, links and buttons turned over under the pointer, the rail's sections as folders). On Architrave's page.
settings.label: Text-mode parts

settings.means: A terminal window's title bar across the top of the paper, holding the paper's own squares, with the page's file, the program and the window's columns and rows: off (the rest) or on. On Architrave's framed page.
settings.label: Window bar

settings.means: A line at the foot of the paper that follows the scroll: off (the rest), pager (the file's name, the lines shown and how far in, turned over, as a pager prints it) or bar (an editor's coloured status bar). On Architrave's framed page.
settings.label: Status line

settings.means: A shell's prompt before the page with the command that shows it, and an empty prompt with the cursor after it: off (the rest), still, or typed (the command typed on arrival, then the page printed a line at a time). Nothing moves for readers who ask for less motion. On Architrave's page.
settings.label: Prompt

settings.means: The terminal's cursor in the prompt and the status line: blink (a blinking block, the rest), still (a block) or bar (a thin bar).
settings.label: Cursor

settings.means: The title and the headings standing out of the page on a hard block of the second light, one step a pixel, no blur, as an arcade marquee's letters: off (the rest), diagonal or down. The title three steps deep, a heading two. Composes with the glow, the bloom and the fringe.
settings.label: Extrusion

settings.means: The corner a pixel screen draws when it rounds: the paper's corners and the pictures' cut in stairs of whole pixels. Off (the rest) or on. Best with square corners.
settings.label: Pixel corners

settings.means: How far the reader is, the arcade's way: twenty blocks along the paper's foot, one lit for every twentieth read, the last one lit in the second light. Off (the rest) or on. Architrave's paper only.
settings.label: Power bar

settings.means: A café's awning across the top of the paper, in the ground's colour and the paper's, scrolling away with the page: off (the rest), stripes (striped, its edge cut in scallops) or scallops (one colour, the scalloped edge only). Architrave's paper only.
settings.label: Awning

settings.means: A round stamp on the corner of an article's opening picture, as on a postcard: the site's name and the article's first category around it, the name's first letter inside, in the title's colour. Off (the rest) or on. Architrave's articles only.
settings.label: Stamp

settings.means: A small mark under the article's title, in the title's colour, standing where the highlighter's bar stands: off (the rest), wave (a short wave, the sea in front of the café) or star (a six-pointed star).
settings.label: Mark under the title

settings.means: A small star over each of the article's section headings, in the accent: off (the rest) or on.
settings.label: Star over headings

settings.means: The pictures' corners: cards (the rest, the corners every card and button has) or square (pictures cut square while cards and buttons keep theirs, as photographs beside rounded cards).
settings.label: Picture corners

settings.means: A soft shadow under the pictures, so a white screenshot stands off a white paper or card: off (the rest) or soft. By night the shadow is a faint light edge instead. Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Picture shadow

settings.means: The colour of the article's section headings when the headings' role has a colour of its own (accent or own): title (the rest, the same colour as the title) or ink (the text's colour, so only the title stands in the colour).
settings.label: Section headings

settings.means: The article's first paragraph speaks up, as a launch page opens on one big sentence: off (the rest) or big (1.4 times the text, medium, in the ink). Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Opening sentence

settings.means: The pictures in the article's text as wide as the wide top picture, centred on the column, with more air around them: off (the rest) or on. Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Wide pictures in the text

settings.means: How the article's parts and the list's posts come into view as the page scrolls: none (the rest: they are simply there), rise (each rises 40px into place, once; the title, its date and its picture one after another on arrival) or zoom (the same, the pictures coming in from a small zoom). Nothing moves for readers who ask for less motion. Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Arrival on scroll

settings.means: Once the paper scrolls, its top turns to frosted glass under the corner squares, and the words run under it: off (the rest) or on. Architrave's framed paper only.
settings.label: Glass at the top

settings.means: The quiet buttons inside the article's boxes (the support box, a release's actions): pill (the rest: as the other buttons) or link (the accent's text links ending on a chevron, as a 'Learn more' link; the filled button stays the one button). Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Buttons in boxes

settings.means: Each post of a list on its own tile in the card colour, as wide as the wide top picture plus a gutter, its corner the picture's plus that gutter; the boxes on a tile take the paper: off (the rest) or on. Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Posts on tiles

settings.means: Link cards and the list's tiles under the pointer: off (the rest: their colour changes as ever) or grow (they grow by one percent with a soft shadow). Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Tiles under the pointer

settings.means: The framed paper as an old television's screen: off (the rest), round (the screen's grain, scan lines and vignette lie on the paper and not on the window, its edges fall dark, a black mask round it, and the corner buttons turn round with the corner nested to them) or square (the same with the corner buttons and the corner as they are). Architrave's framed paper only; without a paper the window stays the screen.
settings.label: Tube face

settings.means: What stands round the screen: off (the rest: the ground as the colours give it), walnut (veneer) or bakelite (a deep brown). The same by day and by night; the rail's words, lines and logo stand on it in ivory. Architrave's framed page only.
settings.label: Cabinet

settings.means: A faint second copy of the words a little to the right, the signal arriving twice: off (the rest), titles (the title and the headings) or all (every word, fainter).
settings.label: Ghost image

settings.means: The article's title as a television's title card: centred between two thin frames, its kicker and date centred with it. Off (the rest) or on. Architrave's page only.
settings.label: Title card

settings.means: A broad soft band of less light drifting slowly up the screen, as the mains hummed through an old set: off (the rest) or slow. On the paper under Tube face, over the window elsewhere. Still for readers who ask for less motion.
settings.label: Hum bar

settings.means: A solid block of the accent over the article's head, the mark a poster opens with: off (the rest) or on. Above the categories when they stand over the title.
settings.label: Colour block

settings.means: A rule in the ink over each of the article's section headings, the way a poster divides its fields: off (the rest), thin (2px) or thick (6px).
settings.label: Section rules

settings.means: Each section heading's number stands over it, big and in the accent: off (the rest), written (only a number the heading already begins with, "1. …", taken out of its line) or counted (every section numbered, a written number kept).
settings.label: Section numbers

settings.means: Strength of the scan lines, 1 to 10 (opacity in hundredths). 3 is the rest. Only with scanlines.
settings.label: Scan line strength

settings.means: Strength of those lines: the ink's share in the line colour, in per cent. 45 is the rest. Only with lines.
settings.label: Line strength

settings.means: Strength of the fills as a percentage of the colour pair's own steps; 100 is the rest. Only with fills.
settings.label: Fill strength

settings.means: Strength of the glow, 1 to 10. 4 is the rest. Only with glow.
settings.label: Glow strength

settings.means: Strength of the grain, 1 to 10. 4 is the rest. Only with grain.
settings.label: Grain strength

settings.means: Strength of the vignette, 1 to 10. 2 is the rest. Only with vignette.
settings.label: Vignette strength

settings.means: How far the vignette reaches in from the edges, 1 to 6. 3 is the rest. Only with vignette.
settings.label: Vignette size

settings.means: How far the reading text steps toward the paper, in percent: 10 to 45 in steps of 5. 15 is the rest. Only with soft.
settings.label: Softness

settings.means: How far the small text (dates, captions, meta) steps toward the paper with soft on, in percent: 25 to 50 in steps of 5. 25 is the rest. Only with soft, and only while smallsoft is not set; the row Small text writes smallsoft since 2026-09-27.

How far the small text (dates, captions, meta) steps toward the paper, in percent: 0 (the ink itself) to 50 in steps of 5, with soft on or off. 25 is the rest, the pair's own rung. Not set, it follows quietlevel while soft is on, and an export leaves it out.

How links in the text are marked: both (the rest: the accent and an underline), coloured (the accent, underlined only under the pointer), underlined (the ink with a quiet underline) or bold (the ink on a thick underline in the accent, filled with the accent under the pointer). Not set, a style with soft marks them underlined, and an export leaves it out.
solid, dashed or dotted lines. Dashes are long only when rounded is false. Only with lines.
settings.label: Line style

settings.means: medium, small or large corners. One step re-cuts every corner together; nested corners stay sums. Only with rounded.
settings.label: Corner size

settings.means: which edges of the top picture fade with picturefade: sides (bottom and sides), bottom, or all four.
settings.label: Edges

settings.means: The highlighter's colour: yellow, green, pink, blue, orange, text (the reading text's colour), muted (the date's colour), or own (the well colours.<side>.marker, fitted to the other side's paper when set on one side only; its ink and bar follow from the pen). Only with marker.
settings.label: Highlighter colour

settings.means: What the frame around pictures shows: plain, dots (the dot grid) or checker (a transparency checkerboard). Only with pictureframe.
settings.label: Frame pattern

settings.means: Line length of the reading text in letters: 60 to 88 in steps of 4. 72 is the rest.
settings.label: Line length

settings.means: The space of the page: xcompact, compact, standard, spacious or xspacious. Standard is the rest, the theme's own. Each kind of gap moves by its own amount: inside a group a little, between items more, between sections most, so what belongs together stays together. The reading text of an article keeps its own rhythm.
settings.label: Space

settings.means: Width of the frame around pictures in pixels: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 or 32. 8 is the rest. Only with pictureframe.
settings.label: Frame width

settings.means: The dot grid's spacing in pixels: 16 (fine), 24 or 32 (wide). 24 is the rest. Only with dots.
settings.label: Grid size

settings.means: Strength of the dots: the ink's share in the dot colour, in per cent: 6, 9, 13, 18 or 24. 13 is the rest. Only with dots.
settings.label: Dot strength

settings.means: true when the light and dark colours were set independently; false lets one side follow the other.
settings.label: Same colours for light and dark

settings.defMeans: absent: the member follows its role's own dial (members[].rest gives its resting size)
settings.label: Size

settings.defMeans: absent: the member follows its role's own dial (members[].rest gives its resting size)
settings.label: Weight

settings.defMeans: absent: the member follows its role's own dial (members[].rest gives its resting size)
settings.label: Own capitals

settings.defMeans: absent: the member follows its role's own dial (members[].rest gives its resting size)
settings.label: Character spacing

settings.defMeans: absent: the member follows its role's own dial (members[].rest gives its resting size)
settings.label: Alignment
Fades to
settings.means: Title finish, fades to: how far Shine fades, the share of the colour it ends on: 50 (the rest), 70 or 30.

settings.label: Direction
settings.means: Title finish, direction: which way the finish runs: diagonal (the rest, top left to bottom right), down, or across.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Title finish, colour: the colour the Accent finish runs into: light (the rest; the accent until a Light is set), second (Second light), accent or ink.

settings.label: Reaches
settings.means: Title finish, reaches: all headings (the rest) or the title alone.

settings.label: Which words
settings.means: Serif words, which words: which words of a heading take the serif of Italics in headings: the italics a writer set (the rest), the last word of every title and heading, or the whole title.

settings.label: Style
settings.means: Serif words, style: italic (the rest) or upright.

settings.label: Speed
settings.means: Headings arrive, speed: calm (the rest), quick or slow.

settings.label: Blur
settings.means: Headings arrive, blur: how blurred the words start with Blur to sharp: medium (8, the rest), light (4) or strong (14).

settings.label: Also
settings.means: Headings arrive, also: the headings only (the rest), the paragraphs too, or the paragraphs and the pictures too.

settings.label: Strength
settings.means: Card light, strength: its strength in percent: 100 (the rest), 25, 50 or 75.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Card light, colour: auto (the rest: the ink by night, the accent by day), light, second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Edge
settings.means: Card light, edge: how much of the top edge is lit: medium (70, the rest), short (40) or full (100).

settings.label: Glow reach
settings.means: Card light, glow reach: how far the glow falls into the card: medium (55, the rest), small (35) or large (85).

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Moving light, colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Speed
settings.means: Moving light, speed: seconds a run takes: medium (7, the rest), slow (11) or fast (4).

settings.label: Streak
settings.means: Moving light, streak: the streak's length in percent: medium (34, the rest), short (20) or long (55).

settings.label: Where
settings.means: Moving light, where: the cards (the rest), the buttons too, or the article's dividers too.

settings.label: Rhythm
settings.means: Moving light, rhythm: always (the rest) or now and then.

settings.label: Glow colour
settings.means: Button finish, glow colour: the light under the main button with Glow: fill (the rest: its own colour), light, second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Glow
settings.means: Button finish, glow: the glow's strength: medium (75, the rest), soft (40) or strong (100).

settings.label: Ring
settings.means: Button finish, ring: a ring of the glow colour round the main button: on (the rest) or off.

settings.label: Lift
settings.means: Button finish, lift: the main button lifts under the pointer: on (the rest) or off.

settings.label: Light sweep
settings.means: Button finish, light sweep: a band of light crosses a button under the pointer: off (the rest) or on.

settings.label: Glass
settings.means: Button finish, glass: how strong the glass is: medium (2, the rest), faint (1) or strong (3).

settings.label: Strength
settings.means: Pattern at the top, strength: its strength in percent of today's: 100 (the rest), 25, 50 or 75.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Pattern at the top, colour: ink (the rest), light, second or accent.

settings.label: Size
settings.means: Pattern at the top, size: medium (the rest), fine or wide.

settings.label: Reach
settings.means: Pattern at the top, reach: how far down it reaches before it has faded: medium (560 px, the rest), short (300), long (900) or the whole paper.

settings.label: Strength
settings.means: Guides, strength: their strength: 100 (the rest: today's), or 25, 50 or 75 percent of a share of 30.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Guides, colour: ink (the rest), light, second or accent.

settings.label: Corner marks
settings.means: Guides, corner marks: a small cross at the four corners: off (the rest) or on.

settings.label: Tint with
settings.means: Tint the greys, tint with: the colour the greys take: light (the rest; the accent until a Light is set), second or accent.

settings.label: First colour
settings.means: Aurora, first colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Second colour
settings.means: Aurora, second colour: second (the rest), light, accent or ink.

settings.label: Place
settings.means: Aurora, place: behind the title (the rest), the top of the page, or the whole article.

settings.label: Speed
settings.means: Aurora, speed: slow (the rest), still or lively.

settings.label: Shape
settings.means: Aurora, shape: soft glows (the rest) or two beams of light.

settings.label: Pointer light
settings.means: Pointer light, pointer light: a soft light under the pointer on the cards: off (the rest) or on.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Pointer light, colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Dividers
settings.means: Dividers, dividers: the article's dividers: plain (the rest), fading ends, or fading ends with a glow.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Dividers, colour: the glow's colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Paper top line
settings.means: Paper top line, paper top line: a bright line along the paper's top edge: off (the rest) or on. The framed paper only.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Paper top line, colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Picture edge light
settings.means: Picture edge light, picture edge light: a light at the edge of the article's pictures: off (the rest), soft or strong.

settings.label: Colour
settings.means: Picture edge light, colour: light (the rest), second, accent or ink.

settings.label: Curve
settings.means: Monitor frame, curve: the frame's corner: round (the rest), slight or bulged.

settings.label: Glass sheen
settings.means: Monitor frame, glass sheen: a faint light across the glass's top corner: off (the rest) or on.

settings.label: Direction
settings.means: Warp, direction: the edges pulled in (the rest) or magnified out.

settings.label: Glows on
settings.means: Glow, glows on: which words glow by night: all text (the rest) or the headings only, the reading left clean.

settings.label: By night
settings.means: Vignette, by night: the vignette's strength on the dark side: the same as by day (the rest) or half, since a pale haze shows far more on a dark ground.

settings.label: By night in
settings.means: Vignette, by night in: the colour the edges darken toward on the dark side: the ink (the rest), which reads as a pale haze, or black, as a screen's glass falls off into the dark.

settings.label: By day
settings.means: Vignette, by day: the vignette's strength on the light side: the same as set (the rest) or half.
